mechanics.claim: The mark refreshes on subsequent hits and expires when Renata attacks a different enemy, so only one target is marked at a time.
mechanics.quote: apply a mark that lasts 6 seconds, refreshes on subsequent hits and expires when attacking a new enemy

mechanics.claim: The bonus damage only triggers on the hit that first applies the mark (i.e. when the target was unmarked); it does not repeat on every attack while the mark persists.
mechanics.quote: If the enemy was unmarked, the attack also deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: Allied champions' damaging attacks and abilities against a marked target consume the mark to deal additional bonus magic damage, a separate damage instance from Renata's own proc.
mechanics.quote: Allied {{tip|champions|champions'}} damaging attacks and {{tip|abilities}} against a marked target will consume the mark to deal {{as|magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: Leverage's damage is capped against epic monsters, which does not apply to a champion dummy target.
mechanics.quote: ''Leverage's'' damage is capped at 150 against epic {{tip|monsters}}.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield does not block the mark's application.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will not block the mark's application.

mechanics.claim: The mark is applied even if the attack misses due to blind.
mechanics.quote: ''Leverage's'' mark will be applied even if the attack misses due to {{tip|blind}}.
